title: Complete proof of Erdős Problem #104: Unit Circles Through Three Points

problemStatement.plain: Formal mathematical investigation: Complete proof of Erdős Problem #104: Unit Circles Through Three Points.

proven: two_points_no_circle: if dist(p,q) > 2, no unit circle goes through both
open: The main conjecture: O(n^{3/2}) unit circles with 3+ points
